painpoints.text: gh CLI missing from THIS run environment too — the mandated in-flight PR check degraded fail-open again this pass (run on branch fabro/run/01M1YTVK73YEJXW4542MWDX4BJ), exactly the behavior fabro-05d0 was filed against; implementing that seed is the fix.

observations: Seed fabro-05d0 names `.fabro/Dockerfile` as the fix target, but that file already installs gh since commit 98ed9f1 (2026-09-05); the live toolchain image is `.fabro/Dockerfile.toolchain` (no gh). Brief corrects the target file — basis otherwise fresh.
Auth is the hidden half of this seed: without GH_TOKEN in run containers the guard still fails after the binary lands; brief requires the implementer to verify token plumbing before declaring done.
